subject: Removal of existing cold storage and re-installation — supply and installation of new 100 mm sandwich panel system, new concrete flooring with epoxy finish, re-installation of the existing door and existing refrigeration equipment, gas charging, testing, commissioning and handover (10.00 × 4.00 × 3.00 m)
intro: Dear Sir, with reference to the above subject, we thank you for the opportunity to quote for the removal of your existing cold storage room and its re-installation with a new sandwich panel envelope and new concrete flooring. Our offer covers the dismantling of the existing room, supply and installation of the new panel system, re-installation of your existing door and existing refrigeration equipment, new concrete and epoxy flooring, gas charging, testing, commissioning and handover, as detailed below.

boq.description: Removal and dismantling of the existing cold storage room (10.00 × 4.00 × 3.00 m) — sandwich wall and ceiling panels, insulated floor system, cold room door, condensing unit, evaporator, piping and electrical accessories. Includes careful removal and safe stacking of items to be re-used, and clearing of all debris from site.
Supply and installation of complete 100 mm PUF sandwich panel system to walls and ceiling — 124.00 sqm total — including aluminium coving, corner angles, silicone sealing and full vapour sealing.
Re-installation of the existing cold room door removed under item 1, including frame alignment, gasket adjustment, hardware re-fixing and sealing.

Supply and installation of new concrete flooring with epoxy finish — 40.00 sqm. Sub-floor preparation; 500 gauge polythene damp-proof membrane, lapped and sealed; A142 steel mesh reinforcement; 100 mm reinforced concrete screed, grade C25/30, laid to falls where required and power-float finished; three-coat food-grade epoxy system (primer, self-levelling body coat, chemical-resistant top coat) to nominal 2 mm; 100 mm epoxy coving to all wall-to-floor junctions for hygienic cleaning.

Re-installation of the condensing unit and evaporator removed under item 1 — including mounting and fixing, interconnecting copper pipework with armaflex insulation, insulated drain line, complete electrical re-wiring, control wiring and terminations.
Refrigerant gas charging, including pressure testing, leak testing and vacuum.
Testing and commissioning of the complete installation, including temperature pull-down verification.
Handover to client, including operational check and demonstration of the installed system.

delivery.Material Delivery: 5 – 7 days from date of LPO and approved advance payment
delivery.Site Mobilization: Within 3 working days of material arrival at site
delivery.Installation Period: 12 – 15 working days — removal, panel work, then concrete and epoxy flooring
delivery.Testing & Commissioning: 2 – 3 working days after installation completion, following concrete curing
delivery.Total Project Duration: 20 – 25 working days from LPO (subject to site readiness)
